name: Dust_Adder
lore: Dusty and quick, it vanishes into the dry ground.

name: Rock_Snake
lore: It sleeps among boulders so long that moss mistakes it for stone.

name: Hog_Nosed_Snake
lore: When cornered it rolls over and plays dead, badly.

name: Scrub_Racer
lore: Too fast for anything in the scrub to catch.

name: Clay_Snake
lore: Baked red by the sun, it hardens at the first sign of a fight.

name: Rust_Viper
lore: Its scales flake like old iron, and its bite is just as hard.

name: Dune_Viper
lore: It drifts sideways over the dunes, leaving only wavy tracks.

name: Mesa_Adder
lore: Banded like the red cliffs it hides in.

name: Bull_Snake
lore: Hisses like a rattler and hits like a bull.

name: Prairie_Rattler
lore: Hear the rattle and you are already in range.

name: Stone_Constrictor
lore: It squeezes until the pebbles in its path turn to sand.

name: Iron_Snake
lore: Forged by a thousand rainy seasons in the old mine.

name: Sandstorm_Asp
lore: Wears the desert wind like a golden hood.

name: Tiger_Snake
lore: Stripes like a tiger and a temper to match.

name: Bushmaster
lore: The largest viper in the dry forest, and the most patient.

name: Basalt_Serpent
lore: Cracks glow orange where the lava still sleeps beneath its scales.

name: Obsidian_Wyrm
lore: Black glass scales, red veins, and a hunger that never cools.

name: Colossus_Python
lore: It has swallowed three explorers and still looks for more.

name: Pond_Snake
lore: Always found where the lilies are thickest.

name: Reed_Snake
lore: Thin as a reed and just as hard to spot.

name: Brook_Snake
lore: It follows the stream wherever the water takes it.

name: Eel_Snake
lore: Half eel, half snake, all slippery.

name: Ripple_Snake
lore: Each ring on its skin is a ripple that never fades.

name: Moray_Viper
lore: Its jaws snap from the reef before the fish even sees it.

name: Cottonmouth
lore: It gapes pale and wide before it strikes.

name: Reef_Adder
lore: A flash of orange and blue on the coral.

name: Tide_Snake
lore: It rises and falls with the moon.

name: Kelp_Snake
lore: It wears the forest of the sea on its back.

name: Lagoon_Python
lore: Warm shallows, golden spots, and a long, lazy squeeze.

name: Tempest_Serpent
lore: Lightning follows wherever it swims.

name: Abyssal_Eel
lore: Lured by its glowing lights, few ever surface again.

name: Pearl_Serpent
lore: Its scales shimmer like the inside of a shell.

name: Siren_Snake
lore: Its song sounds like someone you miss.

name: Glacier_Adder
lore: Frozen in a glacier for a thousand years, and angry about it.

name: Maelstrom_Serpent
lore: It coils into a whirlpool and drags ships to the deep.

name: Coral_Dragon
lore: Reef kings once crowned it a dragon, and it never argued.

name: Storm_Leviathan
lore: When it breaches, the sky turns to follow.

name: Leaf_Snake
lore: Hangs among the leaves and fools the wind.

name: Twig_Snake
lore: Not a branch, whatever the birds think.

name: Moss_Snake
lore: Slow, damp and fuzzy with green.

name: Bark_Snake
lore: Rough scales, rougher manners.

name: Fern_Snake
lore: Unfurls at dawn like a young fern.

name: Orchid_Snake
lore: Beautiful, and every bit as poisonous as it looks.

name: Emerald_Boa
lore: A green jewel wound around a branch.

name: Jungle_Racer
lore: It races the monkeys and wins.

name: Canopy_Viper
lore: Its red tail flickers like a flower to lure the unwary.

name: Bamboo_Pit_Viper
lore: Sits so still that bamboo grows around it.

name: Liana_Snake
lore: A vine that learned to bite.

name: Chameleon_Snake
lore: Its colours change with its mood, mostly angry.

name: Mossback_Python
lore: Entire ferns grow on its back, and it lets them.

name: Thornback_Viper
lore: Every inch of its spine is a warning.

name: Blossom_Boa
lore: Spring follows it everywhere, in pink.

name: Amber_Tree_Viper
lore: Golden eyes, golden scales, a golden branch to hang from.

name: Venom_Vine
lore: Its purple bands drip with poison.

name: Elderwood_Wyrm
lore: Older than the forest, and the forest is very old.

name: Canopy_King
lore: All the branches bow when it passes.

name: Wisp_Snake
lore: A glimmer on the marsh that follows you home.

name: Gloom_Snake
lore: It brings the dark to every room.

name: Ash_Snake
lore: What remains after the fire has forgotten.

name: Mist_Snake
lore: Hard to hit when it is mostly fog.

name: Wraith_Adder
lore: Its glowing eyes are the last thing most things see.

name: Bone_Viper
lore: A viper that forgot to stop after dying.

name: Phantom_Racer
lore: You only see it after it has passed through you.

name: Dusk_Snake
lore: Born where the sunset meets the first star.

name: Cursed_Snake
lore: Bound in rags and bitter to the last.

name: Grave_Snake
lore: It guards the old stones, and the old stones guard it.

name: Banshee_Serpent
lore: Its wail turns warriors to statues.

name: Lich_Snake
lore: A dead king's mind in a living green body.

name: Soul_Eater
lore: Every soul it swallows adds one more spark.

name: Nightmare_Adder
lore: Coils in the corner of every bad dream.

name: Plague_Wraith
lore: A sickly green mist wearing a snake's shape.

name: Reaper_Serpent
lore: It does not strike. It simply arrives.

name: Void_Wyrm
lore: A hole in the night in the shape of a snake.

name: Phantom_King
lore: Rules a court of the quietly dead.

name: Candy_Snake
lore: Sweet to look at, sticky to fight.

name: Confetti_Snake
lore: Every day is a party where it lives.

name: Jelly_Snake
lore: Wobbles, shines and is surprisingly hard to bite.

name: Prism_Adder
lore: Split the light and you will find it in the middle.

name: Carnival_Snake
lore: The best show in town, and it wants an audience.

name: Opal_Snake
lore: Milky and bright, with a fire inside.

name: Parrot_Snake
lore: Squawks, preens and bites with a hooked grin.

name: Aurora_Serpent
lore: Wears the northern lights like a cape.

name: Kaleido_Viper
lore: Turn it just a little and it becomes someone else.

name: Sunset_Boa
lore: Every evening the sky borrows its colours.

name: Chromatic_Wyrm
lore: A dragon in every colour, flawless in none.

name: Spectrum_Basilisk
lore: One glance and the rainbow rules you.

name: Jormungandr
lore: The sea serpent that circles the world, and its frozen breath sinks fleets.

name: Quetzalcoatl
lore: The feathered serpent who brought the rain and the dawn on emerald wings.

name: Apophis
lore: Every night it swallows the sun, and every dawn the sun barely escapes.

name: Ouroboros
lore: It devours its own tail and is reborn in every colour of light.

name: Nagaraja
lore: The golden serpent king whose many hoods shelter the mountain of the sun.

name: Skinny_Snake
lore: So thin it slips through the cracks of the Dustwild roads.

name: Spiral_Snake
lore: Coils into a whirlpool that pulls its prey under.
